action: Operators of Quantum Systems drones: follow the company's and your authority's guidance before flying, and do not install software updates until the company confirms they are safe.
exec: A cyberattack on a defence supplier has taken military equipment out of service, showing supplier risk reaching operations.
plain: German drone maker Quantum Systems confirmed a cyberattack, detected in late October, that disrupted its operations. Reports point to a harmful software update, and the German military has grounded the company's drones.
summary: The German drone maker confirmed a cyberattack, detected in late October and attributed to hostile actors, that disrupted operations. Reports point to a malicious software update, and the German military has grounded the company's drones.
title: German military grounds Quantum Systems drones after cyberattack on the maker

validation.note: Two outlets report the company's confirmation.
